thought.text: The server is now unresponsive to lightweight requests. Let me investigate — check the process state, logs, and whether it's stuck.

reasoning_content:
Interesting — the server is no longer responding to lightweight requests! The `info` endpoint timed out after 10 seconds. This suggests that the check (observer execution) is blocking the event loop, or the server is single-threaded and busy. Or is the process hanging/dead?

Let's check the process state and recent logs.

action.command: cd /workspace && date && ps -o pid,etime,time,stat,comm -p 21596 && echo "=== LOG TAIL ===" && tail -20 badge-api-serve.log && echo "=== PORT ===" && (ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 8080 || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep 8080) && echo "=== TRY INFO again ===" && curl -s -m 15 -o /dev/null -w "info:%{http_code} time:%{time_total}\n" http://localhost:8080/api/v1/info
